name: Curtain reveal glow title
what: Two velvet stage curtains meet at the centre and are drawn apart to the sides, bunching up as they go; through the gap a giant glowing title shrinks down to rest on a softly lit dark stage, then holds.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f2 the curtains meet at the centre; f3-f21 they are drawn apart (the gap grows about 29 px a frame, fast at first) and gather at the sides, clear at f21; f3-f30 the title behind them shrinks from 3.4 times its size to rest (fast at first, then settling); then it holds to the end

tracks.name: curtains
tracks.what: the two curtains are drawn apart and bunch up at the sides

tracks.name: title
tracks.what: the glowing title shrinks from 3.4 times its size to rest

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the title rests on the lit stage (the film grain moves)
